# 0) Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(hgu133plus2.db)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(20260421)

# Do not modify this file. It contains ml_sum(), result_plot(), and result_plot2().
source("SSV summary.R")

result_dir <- "results_deepcc_gse13067_to_gse13294_internal_platform"
dir.create(result_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Setup done.\n")
cat("Working directory:", getwd(), "\n")
cat("Result directory:", result_dir, "\n")
```

# 1) Design

This file uses DeepCC CRC scenario 1 as a binary SSV adaptation within a microarray-only setting:

-   `class_id = 1`: CMS4
-   `class_id = 0`: Others = CMS1 + CMS2 + CMS3
-   `batch_id = 1`: GSE13067 RMA microarray
-   `batch_id = 2`: GSE13294 RMA microarray
-   `split = 100`: strict internal-platform cross-dataset validation, GSE13067 as train-like batch and GSE13294 as external batch.

Compared with the TCGA-to-GEO files, this workflow is simplified because both expression files are already RMA microarray matrices with the same Affymetrix probe ID structure. Therefore:

1.  No TCGA parser is used.
2.  No TCGA primary-tumor filtering is needed.
3.  No RNA-seq-to-microarray scale alignment is required by default.
4.  Feature selection is still based on batch 1 only, GSE13067, to avoid using batch 2 expression values to choose classifier features.

The optional `internal_alignment_method` is kept for diagnostics. The default is `"none"`, because both inputs are RMA log-scale microarray data. If the raw RMA distributions are still too different, you can change it to `"sample_rank_normal"`.

# 2) Parameters

```{r parameters}
gse13067_expr_path <- "validation_s1/gse13067_rma_expression.tsv"
gse13294_expr_path <- "validation_s1/gse13294_rma_expression.tsv"
label_path <- "label/cms_labels_public_all.txt"

batch1_dataset_name <- "gse13067"
batch2_dataset_name <- "gse13294"

valid_cms <- c("CMS1", "CMS2", "CMS3", "CMS4")
binary_positive_class <- "CMS4"
binary_negative_class <- "Others"

# ml_sum settings
split_combination <- c(50, 70, 80, 90, 100)
times <- 10
ml_methods <- c("knn", "lasso", "svm", "pam", "rf", "xgb")
batch_balance <- FALSE

# Feature selection is based on batch 1 only to avoid batch 2 leakage.
feature_selection_method <- "top_batch1_mean"
top_n_features <- 1500

# Internal-platform alignment.
# Recommended default here: "none", because both datasets are RMA microarray log-scale.
# Optional alternatives: "sample_rank_normal", "sample_zscore".
internal_alignment_method <- "none"

file_prefix <- file.path(result_dir, "deepcc_gse13067_to_gse13294_CMS4_vs_Others_internal_platform")

cat("Batch 1 expression path:", gse13067_expr_path, "\n")
cat("Batch 2 expression path:", gse13294_expr_path, "\n")
cat("Label path:", label_path, "\n")
cat("Binary class:", binary_positive_class, "vs", binary_negative_class, "\n")
cat("Feature selection:", feature_selection_method, "top_n =", top_n_features, "\n")
cat("Internal alignment method:", internal_alignment_method, "\n")
cat("File prefix:", file_prefix, "\n")
```

# 3) Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
to_numeric_matrix <- function(df_like) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df_like)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  mat
}

clean_geo_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x |>
    gsub("\\.CEL$", "", x = _, ignore.case = TRUE) |>
    trimws()
}

read_rma_expr_no_gene_header <- function(path, dataset_label) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Cannot find expression file for ", dataset_label, ": ", path)

  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(lines) < 2) stop("Expression file format unexpected for ", dataset_label, ": less than 2 lines.")

  sample_ids <- strsplit(lines[1], "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  body <- read.delim(
    text = paste(lines[-1], collapse = "\n"),
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if (ncol(body) != length(sample_ids) + 1) {
    stop("Parse mismatch for ", dataset_label, ": body columns do not match sample header columns.")
  }

  colnames(body) <- c("probe_id", sample_ids)
  body$probe_id <- as.character(body$probe_id)
  body <- body[!duplicated(body$probe_id), , drop = FALSE]
  body
}

collapse_gse_probe_to_symbol <- function(mat, dataset_label) {
  probe_ids <- rownames(mat)

  symbol_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    hgu133plus2.db,
    keys = probe_ids,
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "PROBEID",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  keep <- !is.na(symbol_map) & symbol_map != ""
  cat(dataset_label, "mapped probes:", sum(keep), "out of", length(probe_ids), "\n")

  mat2 <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  gene_symbol <- unname(symbol_map[keep])

  df <- as.data.frame(mat2, check.names = FALSE)
  df$gene_symbol <- gene_symbol

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_symbol) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  out <- as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(out) <- out$gene_symbol
  out$gene_symbol <- NULL
  as.matrix(out)
}

matrix_diagnostics <- function(mat, name, n_show = 5) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  cat("\n--- Diagnostics:", name, "---\n")
  cat("dim:", paste(dim(mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
  cat("NA count:", sum(is.na(mat)), "\n")
  cat("Non-finite count:", sum(!is.finite(mat)), "\n")
  cat("Value summary:\n")
  print(summary(as.numeric(mat)))
  cat("Sample median summary:\n")
  print(summary(apply(mat, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("Sample sd summary:\n")
  print(summary(apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("Gene mean summary:\n")
  print(summary(rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("First genes:", paste(head(rownames(mat), n_show), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("First samples:", paste(head(colnames(mat), n_show), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

sample_rank_normalize <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  out <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    ok <- is.finite(x)
    z <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
    if (sum(ok) <= 1) {
      z[ok] <- 0
    } else {
      r <- rank(x[ok], ties.method = "average", na.last = "keep")
      p <- (r - 0.5) / sum(ok)
      z[ok] <- qnorm(p)
    }
    z
  })

  out <- as.matrix(out)
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

sample_zscore <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  out <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    mu <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    sdv <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(sdv) || sdv == 0) sdv <- 1
    (x - mu) / sdv
  })

  out <- as.matrix(out)
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

apply_internal_alignment <- function(batch1_mat, batch2_mat, method) {
  if (method == "none") {
    list(batch1 = batch1_mat, batch2 = batch2_mat)
  } else if (method == "sample_rank_normal") {
    list(batch1 = sample_rank_normalize(batch1_mat), batch2 = sample_rank_normalize(batch2_mat))
  } else if (method == "sample_zscore") {
    list(batch1 = sample_zscore(batch1_mat), batch2 = sample_zscore(batch2_mat))
  } else {
    stop("Unknown internal alignment method: ", method)
  }
}

remove_bad_features <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  keep_finite <- rowSums(is.finite(mat)) == ncol(mat)
  keep_var <- apply(mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  keep <- keep_finite & keep_var
  out <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  list(data = out, keep = keep)
}
```

# 4) Read CMS labels

```{r read-labels}
labels_raw <- read.delim(
  label_path,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

label_col <- "CMS_final_network_plus_RFclassifier_in_nonconsensus_samples"
if (!(label_col %in% colnames(labels_raw))) {
  stop("Cannot find CMS label column: ", label_col)
}

labels <- labels_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    dataset = tolower(as.character(dataset)),
    CMS = as.character(.data[[label_col]])
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CMS), CMS %in% valid_cms) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CMS_binary_text = ifelse(CMS == binary_positive_class, binary_positive_class, binary_negative_class),
    class_id = ifelse(CMS == binary_positive_class, 1, 0)
  )

cat("Label table loaded.\n")
cat("Total valid CMS labels:", nrow(labels), "\n")
cat("Dataset distribution in label file:\n")
print(table(labels$dataset))
cat("Original CMS distribution in all labels:\n")
print(table(labels$CMS))
cat("Binary CMS distribution in all labels:\n")
print(table(labels$CMS_binary_text))

cat("Target dataset labels:\n")
print(table(labels$dataset[labels$dataset %in% c(batch1_dataset_name, batch2_dataset_name)]))
```

# 5) Read RMA expression data and inspect file characteristics

```{r read-expression}
gse13067_raw_internal <- read_rma_expr_no_gene_header(gse13067_expr_path, batch1_dataset_name)
gse13294_raw_internal <- read_rma_expr_no_gene_header(gse13294_expr_path, batch2_dataset_name)

cat("GSE13067 raw data.frame dim:", paste(dim(gse13067_raw_internal), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("GSE13294 raw data.frame dim:", paste(dim(gse13294_raw_internal), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("GSE13067 preview:\n")
print(gse13067_raw_internal[1:3, 1:min(6, ncol(gse13067_raw_internal))])
cat("GSE13294 preview:\n")
print(gse13294_raw_internal[1:3, 1:min(6, ncol(gse13294_raw_internal))])

gse13067_probe_mat_internal <- gse13067_raw_internal |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("probe_id") |>
  to_numeric_matrix()

gse13294_probe_mat_internal <- gse13294_raw_internal |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("probe_id") |>
  to_numeric_matrix()

cat("Both files are treated as RMA log-scale microarray matrices. No extra log transform is applied.\n")
cat("Common probe count before gene-symbol collapse:", length(intersect(rownames(gse13067_probe_mat_internal), rownames(gse13294_probe_mat_internal))), "\n")

matrix_diagnostics(gse13067_probe_mat_internal, "GSE13067 RMA probe matrix")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_probe_mat_internal, "GSE13294 RMA probe matrix")
```

# 6) Probe-to-gene harmonization and common-gene restriction

```{r gene-symbol-harmonization}
gse13067_symbol_mat_internal <- collapse_gse_probe_to_symbol(gse13067_probe_mat_internal, "GSE13067")
gse13294_symbol_mat_internal <- collapse_gse_probe_to_symbol(gse13294_probe_mat_internal, "GSE13294")

matrix_diagnostics(gse13067_symbol_mat_internal, "GSE13067 gene-symbol matrix")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_symbol_mat_internal, "GSE13294 gene-symbol matrix")

common_genes_internal <- intersect(rownames(gse13067_symbol_mat_internal), rownames(gse13294_symbol_mat_internal))
cat("GSE13067 gene count:", nrow(gse13067_symbol_mat_internal), "\n")
cat("GSE13294 gene count:", nrow(gse13294_symbol_mat_internal), "\n")
cat("Common gene count:", length(common_genes_internal), "\n")
cat("Common gene preview:\n")
print(head(common_genes_internal, 30))

if (length(common_genes_internal) < 500) {
  stop("Too few common genes after harmonization. Check probe IDs and annotation package.")
}

gse13067_common_internal <- gse13067_symbol_mat_internal[common_genes_internal, , drop = FALSE]
gse13294_common_internal <- gse13294_symbol_mat_internal[common_genes_internal, , drop = FALSE]

matrix_diagnostics(gse13067_common_internal, "GSE13067 common genes before sample matching")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_common_internal, "GSE13294 common genes before sample matching")
```

# 7) Sample alignment with CMS labels

```{r sample-alignment}
gse13067_meta_internal <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_original = colnames(gse13067_common_internal),
  sample_lookup = clean_geo_sample_id(colnames(gse13067_common_internal)),
  dataset = batch1_dataset_name
) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    labels |>
      dplyr::filter(dataset == batch1_dataset_name) |>
      dplyr::rename(sample_lookup = sample),
    by = c("sample_lookup", "dataset")
  )

gse13294_meta_internal <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_original = colnames(gse13294_common_internal),
  sample_lookup = clean_geo_sample_id(colnames(gse13294_common_internal)),
  dataset = batch2_dataset_name
) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    labels |>
      dplyr::filter(dataset == batch2_dataset_name) |>
      dplyr::rename(sample_lookup = sample),
    by = c("sample_lookup", "dataset")
  )

cat("Matched GSE13067 samples:", nrow(gse13067_meta_internal), "\n")
cat("Matched GSE13294 samples:", nrow(gse13294_meta_internal), "\n")

if (nrow(gse13067_meta_internal) == 0 || nrow(gse13294_meta_internal) == 0) {
  stop("Sample alignment failed: no matched samples for GSE13067 or GSE13294.")
}

cat("GSE13067 CMS distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(gse13067_meta_internal$CMS))
cat("GSE13067 binary class distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(gse13067_meta_internal$class_id))
cat("GSE13294 CMS distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(gse13294_meta_internal$CMS))
cat("GSE13294 binary class distribution after matching:\n")
print(table(gse13294_meta_internal$class_id))

gse13067_common_matched_internal <- gse13067_common_internal[, gse13067_meta_internal$sample_original, drop = FALSE]
gse13294_common_matched_internal <- gse13294_common_internal[, gse13294_meta_internal$sample_original, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(gse13067_common_matched_internal), gse13067_meta_internal$sample_original))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(gse13294_common_matched_internal), gse13294_meta_internal$sample_original))

matrix_diagnostics(gse13067_common_matched_internal, "GSE13067 common genes matched samples")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_common_matched_internal, "GSE13294 common genes matched samples")
```

# 8) Batch1-only feature selection

```{r batch1-only-feature-selection}
# Select high-expression features using GSE13067 only.
# This avoids using GSE13294 expression values to decide which genes enter the classifier.
batch1_gene_means_internal <- rowMeans(gse13294_common_matched_internal, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Batch1-only gene mean summary before feature selection:\n")
print(summary(batch1_gene_means_internal))
cat("Batch1-only gene mean quantiles:\n")
print(quantile(batch1_gene_means_internal, probs = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99, 1), na.rm = TRUE))

feature_rank_internal <- order(batch1_gene_means_internal, decreasing = TRUE)
actual_top_n_internal <- min(top_n_features, length(feature_rank_internal))
selected_genes_internal <- names(batch1_gene_means_internal)[feature_rank_internal[seq_len(actual_top_n_internal)]]

cat("Selected genes based on GSE13067-only mean expression:", length(selected_genes_internal), "\n")
cat("Selected gene preview:\n")
print(head(selected_genes_internal, 30))

feature_check_internal <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = names(batch1_gene_means_internal),
  gse13294_batch1_mean = as.numeric(batch1_gene_means_internal),
  selected = names(batch1_gene_means_internal) %in% selected_genes_internal
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(gse13294_batch1_mean))

readr::write_csv(feature_check_internal, file.path(result_dir, "feature_selection_gse13067_only_check.csv"))

hist(
  batch1_gene_means_internal,
  breaks = 200,
  main = "GSE13294-only gene mean distribution for feature selection",
  xlab = "Mean expression in GSE13294 only",
  col = "grey85",
  border = "white"
)
abline(v = min(batch1_gene_means_internal[selected_genes_internal], na.rm = TRUE), col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = paste0("top_n = ", length(selected_genes_internal)),
  col = "red",
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## 8.5) Poor-marker / negative-control marker boxplot by batch
############################################################
## Boxplot of poor-marker reads by batch
## Batch 1 = GSE13294
## Batch 2 = GSE13067
##
## Important:
## This plot is made BEFORE cross-platform alignment.
## It is for diagnostic visualization only and is not used in ml_sum().
############################################################

## 0) Specify the two pre-alignment expression matrices
## rows = genes
## cols = samples

poor_batch1_mat <- gse13294_common_matched_internal
poor_batch2_mat <- gse13067_common_matched_internal

batch1_name <- "13294"
batch2_name <- "13067"

cat("Batch 1 matrix dimension: GSE13294\n")
print(dim(poor_batch1_mat))

cat("Batch 2 matrix dimension: GSE13067\n")
print(dim(poor_batch2_mat))

## 1) Define poor markers
## Prefer TCGA training means if train_gene_means already exists.
## This keeps poor-marker definition consistent with the original workflow.
## If train_gene_means does not exist, define poor markers from the combined GSE matrix.

common_poor_genes <- intersect(rownames(poor_batch1_mat), rownames(poor_batch2_mat))

if (exists("train_gene_means")) {
  poor_gene_means_source <- train_gene_means[
    intersect(names(train_gene_means), common_poor_genes)
  ]
  cat("Poor markers are defined using TCGA training mean expression.\n")
} else {
  poor_gene_means_source <- rowMeans(
    cbind(
      poor_batch1_mat[common_poor_genes, , drop = FALSE],
      poor_batch2_mat[common_poor_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  cat("train_gene_means not found. Poor markers are defined using combined GSE mean expression.\n")
}

poor_q_low  <- 0.10
poor_q_high <- 0.30

poor_lower <- quantile(poor_gene_means_source, probs = poor_q_low,  na.rm = TRUE)
poor_upper <- quantile(poor_gene_means_source, probs = poor_q_high, na.rm = TRUE)

poor_genes <- names(poor_gene_means_source)[
  poor_gene_means_source >= poor_lower &
    poor_gene_means_source <= poor_upper
]

## Exclude ML-selected high-expression features if selected_genes exists.
if (exists("selected_genes")) {
  poor_genes <- setdiff(poor_genes, selected_genes)
}

## Keep only genes available in both GSE datasets
poor_genes <- intersect(poor_genes, common_poor_genes)

cat("\nPoor-marker definition:\n")
cat("Mean-expression quantile window:", poor_q_low, "to", poor_q_high, "\n")
cat("Poor-marker mean lower bound:", poor_lower, "\n")
cat("Poor-marker mean upper bound:", poor_upper, "\n")
cat("Number of poor markers:", length(poor_genes), "\n")

if (length(poor_genes) < 20) {
  stop("Too few poor markers. Widen the quantile window, e.g. 0.10 to 0.50.")
}

## 2) Build poor-marker matrix before cross-platform alignment

batch1_poor <- poor_batch1_mat[poor_genes, , drop = FALSE]  # GSE13294
batch2_poor <- poor_batch2_mat[poor_genes, , drop = FALSE]  # GSE13067

poor_mat_13294_13067 <- cbind(batch1_poor, batch2_poor)

batch_poor_13294_13067 <- factor(
  c(rep(batch1_name, ncol(batch1_poor)),
    rep(batch2_name, ncol(batch2_poor))),
  levels = c(batch1_name, batch2_name)
)

stopifnot(ncol(poor_mat_13294_13067) == length(batch_poor_13294_13067))

## 3) Remove non-finite values

poor_mat_13294_13067[!is.finite(poor_mat_13294_13067)] <- NA

cat("\nFinite values per sample summary:\n")
print(summary(colSums(is.finite(as.matrix(poor_mat_13294_13067)))))

cat("All-NA samples:\n")
print(sum(colSums(is.finite(as.matrix(poor_mat_13294_13067))) == 0))

## 4) Order samples by batch
## Batch order will be:
##   left  = 13294
##   right = 13067

ord_13294_13067 <- order(batch_poor_13294_13067)

poor_mat_13294_13067 <- poor_mat_13294_13067[, ord_13294_13067, drop = FALSE]
batch_poor_13294_13067 <- batch_poor_13294_13067[ord_13294_13067]

## 5) Compute boxplot range

bp_13294_13067 <- boxplot(
  as.data.frame(poor_mat_13294_13067),
  plot = FALSE,
  outline = FALSE
)

ylim_use_13294_13067 <- range(bp_13294_13067$stats, na.rm = TRUE)

## 6) Background blocks for the two batches

batch_runs_13294_13067 <- rle(as.character(batch_poor_13294_13067))
batch_end_13294_13067 <- cumsum(batch_runs_13294_13067$lengths)
batch_start_13294_13067 <- c(1, head(batch_end_13294_13067, -1) + 1)

## Grey / white background blocks
bg_cols_13294_13067 <- c(
  "13294" = "grey92",
  "13067" = "white"
)

## Box colors by batch
box_cols_13294_13067 <- c(
  "13294" = "#00BFC4",
  "13067" = "#F8766D"
)

sample_box_cols_13294_13067 <- adjustcolor(
  box_cols_13294_13067[as.character(batch_poor_13294_13067)],
  alpha.f = 0.45
)

sample_border_cols_13294_13067 <- adjustcolor(
  box_cols_13294_13067[as.character(batch_poor_13294_13067)],
  alpha.f = 0.75
)

legend_box_cols_13294_13067 <- adjustcolor(
  unname(box_cols_13294_13067),
  alpha.f = 0.75
)
names(legend_box_cols_13294_13067) <- names(box_cols_13294_13067)

## Check color matching

if (any(is.na(sample_box_cols_13294_13067)) ||
    any(is.na(sample_border_cols_13294_13067))) {
  stop("Some samples do not have assigned colors. Check batch labels and box_cols_13294_13067 names.")
}

cat("\nBatch counts after ordering:\n")
print(table(batch_poor_13294_13067))

## 7) Define one plotting function to avoid screen/png mismatch

draw_poor_boxplot_13294_13067 <- function() {
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
  
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0.5, ncol(poor_mat_13294_13067) + 0.5),
    ylim = ylim_use_13294_13067,
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Samples ordered by batch",
    ylab = "Poor-marker log-transformed expression",
    main = "Poor-marker expression distribution by batch"
  )
  
  ## Background color by batch
  for (i in seq_along(batch_runs_13294_13067$values)) {
    this_batch <- batch_runs_13294_13067$values[i]
    rect(
      xleft = batch_start_13294_13067[i] - 0.5,
      ybottom = par("usr")[3],
      xright = batch_end_13294_13067[i] + 0.5,
      ytop = par("usr")[4],
      col = bg_cols_13294_13067[this_batch],
      border = NA
    )
  }
  
  ## One box per sample
  boxplot(
    as.data.frame(poor_mat_13294_13067),
    add = TRUE,
    outline = FALSE,
    xaxt = "n",
    col = sample_box_cols_13294_13067,
    border = sample_border_cols_13294_13067,
    boxwex = 0.35,
    lwd = 0.6,
    medlwd = 0.6,
    whisklty = 1,
    staplelty = 1
  )
  
  ## Separator between batch 1 and batch 2
  abline(
    v = batch_end_13294_13067[1] + 0.5,
    lty = 2,
    col = "grey40",
    lwd = 1
  )
  
  ## Batch labels on x-axis
  axis(
    side = 1,
    at = (batch_start_13294_13067 + batch_end_13294_13067) / 2,
    labels = batch_runs_13294_13067$values,
    tick = FALSE,
    cex.axis = 0.9
  )
  
  legend(
    "right",
    legend = names(box_cols_13294_13067),
    fill = legend_box_cols_13294_13067,
    border = box_cols_13294_13067,
    bty = "n",
    title = "Batch",
    cex = 0.85,
    inset = c(0.01, 0)
  )
}

## 8) Plot on screen

draw_poor_boxplot_13294_13067()

## 9) Save plot using exactly the same function

outfile_13294_13067 <- file.path(
  result_dir,
  "poor_marker_boxplot_GSE13294_vs_GSE13067_before_alignment.png"
)

png(
  filename = outfile_13294_13067,
  width = 4200,
  height = 1500,
  res = 300
)

draw_poor_boxplot_13294_13067()

dev.off()

cat("Saved poor-marker boxplot to:\n")
cat(outfile_13294_13067, "\n")
```

# 9) Internal-platform alignment and final ml_sum input

```{r internal-alignment-final-input}
gse13067_selected_internal <- gse13067_common_matched_internal[selected_genes_internal, , drop = FALSE]
gse13294_selected_internal <- gse13294_common_matched_internal[selected_genes_internal, , drop = FALSE]

matrix_diagnostics(gse13067_selected_internal, "GSE13067 selected genes before internal alignment")
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_selected_internal, "GSE13294 selected genes before internal alignment")

aligned_internal <- apply_internal_alignment(
  batch1_mat = gse13294_selected_internal,
  batch2_mat = gse13067_selected_internal,
  method = internal_alignment_method
)

gse13294_aligned_internal <- aligned_internal$batch1
gse13067_aligned_internal <- aligned_internal$batch2

matrix_diagnostics(gse13067_aligned_internal, paste0("GSE13067 after internal alignment: ", internal_alignment_method))
matrix_diagnostics(gse13294_aligned_internal, paste0("GSE13294 after internal alignment: ", internal_alignment_method))

data_final_internal <- cbind(gse13294_aligned_internal, gse13067_aligned_internal)

class_id_binary_internal <- factor(
  c(gse13294_meta_internal$class_id, gse13067_meta_internal$class_id),
  levels = c(0, 1)
)

batch_id_final_internal <- c(
  rep(1, ncol(gse13294_aligned_internal)),
  rep(2, ncol(gse13067_aligned_internal))
)
names(batch_id_final_internal) <- colnames(data_final_internal)

sample_meta_final_internal <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = colnames(data_final_internal),
  dataset = c(rep(batch1_dataset_name, ncol(gse13294_aligned_internal)), rep(batch2_dataset_name, ncol(gse13067_aligned_internal))),
  batch_id = batch_id_final_internal,
  CMS = c(gse13294_meta_internal$CMS, gse13067_meta_internal$CMS),
  CMS_binary = ifelse(as.character(class_id_binary_internal) == "1", binary_positive_class, binary_negative_class),
  class_id = as.character(class_id_binary_internal)
)

bad_removed_internal <- remove_bad_features(data_final_internal)
data_final_clean_internal <- bad_removed_internal$data

cat("Combined data_final_internal dim before bad-feature removal:", paste(dim(data_final_internal), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Combined data_final_clean_internal dim after bad-feature removal:", paste(dim(data_final_clean_internal), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Removed bad features:", nrow(data_final_internal) - nrow(data_final_clean_internal), "\n")

stopifnot(
  ncol(data_final_clean_internal) == length(class_id_binary_internal),
  ncol(data_final_clean_internal) == length(batch_id_final_internal),
  identical(colnames(data_final_clean_internal), names(batch_id_final_internal)),
  !anyNA(class_id_binary_internal),
  all(class_id_binary_internal %in% c(0, 1))
)

cat("Final class x batch table:\n")
print(table(class_id_binary_internal, batch_id_final_internal))
cat("Final CMS x batch table:\n")
print(table(sample_meta_final_internal$CMS, sample_meta_final_internal$batch_id))

matrix_diagnostics(data_final_clean_internal, "Final data passed into ml_sum")

readr::write_csv(sample_meta_final_internal, file.path(result_dir, "sample_meta_final_internal.csv"))
write.table(
  data.frame(gene = rownames(data_final_clean_internal)),
  file = file.path(result_dir, "final_feature_genes_internal.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# 10) PCA check before ML

```{r pca-check, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
pca_input_internal <- t(data_final_clean_internal)
pca_input_internal[!is.finite(pca_input_internal)] <- 0
pca_fit_internal <- prcomp(pca_input_internal, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

pca_df_internal <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(pca_fit_internal$x),
  PC1 = pca_fit_internal$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_fit_internal$x[, 2]
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_final_internal, by = "sample")

p_pca_internal <- ggplot(pca_df_internal, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(batch_id), shape = CMS_binary)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("PCA check: GSE13067 vs GSE13294, alignment = ", internal_alignment_method),
    color = "batch",
    shape = "class"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
print(p_pca_internal)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(result_dir, paste0("pca_before_ml_alignment_", internal_alignment_method, ".png")),
  plot = p_pca_internal,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## 9.5) Post-alignment diagnostic-feature boxplot by batch
############################################################
## Purpose:
##   Explain why the ml_sum() error curve is meaningful under
##   the batch definition:
##     Batch 1 = GSE13294
##     Batch 2 = GSE13067
##
## Important:
##   This plot is made AFTER cross-platform alignment.
##   It uses data_final_clean, which is the same matrix passed
##   into ml_sum().
##
## Note:
##   Section 9 aligns only selected_genes, so the original poor_genes
##   from #8.5 are usually not available after alignment.
##   Therefore, this cell uses a low-to-middle expression diagnostic
##   subset from the aligned features that actually enter ml_sum().
############################################################

## 0) Required post-alignment objects
if (!exists("data_final_clean_internal")) {
  stop("Cannot find data_final_clean_internal. Run Section 9 cross-platform alignment first.")
}

if (!exists("batch_id_final_internal")) {
  stop("Cannot find batch_id_final_internal. Run Section 9 cross-platform alignment first.")
}

if (!exists("batch1_gene_means_internal")) {
  stop("Cannot find batch1_gene_means_internal. Run Section 8 feature selection first.")
}

if (!exists("selected_genes_internal")) {
  stop("Cannot find selected_genes_internal. Run Section 8 feature selection first.")
}

stopifnot(
  ncol(data_final_clean_internal) == length(batch_id_final_internal),
  identical(colnames(data_final_clean_internal), names(batch_id_final_internal))
)

cat("Post-alignment matrix used by ml_sum:\n")
print(dim(data_final_clean_internal))

cat("Batch counts in data_final_clean:\n")
print(table(batch_id_final_internal))

## 1) Define diagnostic features from aligned ml_sum input
## Because data_final_clean only contains selected_genes, we select
## the lower-to-middle expression subset among the available aligned
## ml_sum features, based on training-cohort gene means.

pa_gse_available_genes <- intersect(rownames(data_final_clean_internal), names(batch1_gene_means_internal))

pa_gse_feature_means <- batch1_gene_means_internal[pa_gse_available_genes]

## Low-to-middle window among available ml_sum features.
## This is not the same as #8.5 raw poor_genes.
## It is a post-alignment diagnostic subset from features that enter ml_sum().
pa_gse_q_low  <- 0.10
pa_gse_q_high <- 0.40

pa_gse_lower <- quantile(pa_gse_feature_means, probs = pa_gse_q_low,  na.rm = TRUE)
pa_gse_upper <- quantile(pa_gse_feature_means, probs = pa_gse_q_high, na.rm = TRUE)

pa_gse_diag_genes <- names(pa_gse_feature_means)[
  pa_gse_feature_means >= pa_gse_lower &
    pa_gse_feature_means <= pa_gse_upper
]

cat("\nPost-alignment diagnostic-feature definition:\n")
cat("Feature source: data_final_clean rows, i.e. features entering ml_sum()\n")
cat("Training mean-expression quantile window among aligned features:",
    pa_gse_q_low, "to", pa_gse_q_high, "\n")
cat("Diagnostic-feature mean lower bound:", pa_gse_lower, "\n")
cat("Diagnostic-feature mean upper bound:", pa_gse_upper, "\n")
cat("Number of diagnostic features:", length(pa_gse_diag_genes), "\n")

## Fallback: if too few features, use all aligned ml_sum features
if (length(pa_gse_diag_genes) < 20) {
  warning(
    paste0(
      "Fewer than 20 diagnostic features found. ",
      "Using all data_final_clean features for the post-alignment boxplot."
    )
  )
  pa_gse_diag_genes <- rownames(data_final_clean_internal)
}

## 2) Build post-alignment diagnostic matrix
pa_gse_diag_mat <- data_final_clean_internal[pa_gse_diag_genes, , drop = FALSE]

## Batch labels:
##   batch_id_final == 1 means GSE13294
##   batch_id_final == 2 means GSE13067
pa_gse_batch <- factor(
  ifelse(batch_id_final_internal == 1, "GSE13294", "GSE13067"),
  levels = c("GSE13294", "GSE13067")
)

stopifnot(ncol(pa_gse_diag_mat) == length(pa_gse_batch))

## 3) Remove non-finite values
pa_gse_diag_mat[!is.finite(pa_gse_diag_mat)] <- NA

cat("\nFinite values per sample summary in post-alignment diagnostic matrix:\n")
print(summary(colSums(is.finite(as.matrix(pa_gse_diag_mat)))))

cat("All-NA samples:\n")
print(sum(colSums(is.finite(as.matrix(pa_gse_diag_mat))) == 0))

## 4) Order samples by batch
pa_gse_ord <- order(pa_gse_batch)

pa_gse_diag_mat_ordered <- pa_gse_diag_mat[, pa_gse_ord, drop = FALSE]
pa_gse_batch_ordered <- pa_gse_batch[pa_gse_ord]

## 5) Compute boxplot range
pa_gse_bp <- boxplot(
  as.data.frame(pa_gse_diag_mat_ordered),
  plot = FALSE,
  outline = FALSE
)

pa_gse_ylim_use <- range(pa_gse_bp$stats, na.rm = TRUE)

## 6) Background blocks for the two batches
pa_gse_batch_runs <- rle(as.character(pa_gse_batch_ordered))
pa_gse_batch_end <- cumsum(pa_gse_batch_runs$lengths)
pa_gse_batch_start <- c(1, head(pa_gse_batch_end, -1) + 1)

pa_gse_bg_cols <- c(
  "GSE13294" = "grey92",
  "GSE13067" = "white"
)

pa_gse_box_cols <- c(
  "GSE13294" = "#00BFC4",
  "GSE13067" = "#F8766D"
)

pa_gse_sample_box_cols <- adjustcolor(
  pa_gse_box_cols[as.character(pa_gse_batch_ordered)],
  alpha.f = 0.45
)

pa_gse_sample_border_cols <- adjustcolor(
  pa_gse_box_cols[as.character(pa_gse_batch_ordered)],
  alpha.f = 0.75
)

pa_gse_legend_box_cols <- adjustcolor(
  unname(pa_gse_box_cols),
  alpha.f = 0.75
)
names(pa_gse_legend_box_cols) <- names(pa_gse_box_cols)

if (any(is.na(pa_gse_sample_box_cols)) || any(is.na(pa_gse_sample_border_cols))) {
  stop("Some samples do not have assigned colors. Check pa_gse_batch_ordered and pa_gse_box_cols.")
}

cat("\nPost-alignment batch counts used for plotting:\n")
print(table(pa_gse_batch_ordered))

## 7) Define one plotting function to avoid RStudio/png mismatch
pa_gse_draw_post_alignment_boxplot <- function() {
  pa_gse_old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(pa_gse_old_par))
  
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
  
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0.5, ncol(pa_gse_diag_mat_ordered) + 0.5),
    ylim = pa_gse_ylim_use,
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Samples ordered by batch",
    ylab = "Post-alignment diagnostic-feature expression",
    main = "Post-alignment feature distribution by batch"
  )
  
  ## Background color by batch
  for (pa_gse_i in seq_along(pa_gse_batch_runs$values)) {
    pa_gse_this_batch <- pa_gse_batch_runs$values[pa_gse_i]
    rect(
      xleft = pa_gse_batch_start[pa_gse_i] - 0.5,
      ybottom = par("usr")[3],
      xright = pa_gse_batch_end[pa_gse_i] + 0.5,
      ytop = par("usr")[4],
      col = pa_gse_bg_cols[pa_gse_this_batch],
      border = NA
    )
  }
  
  ## One box per sample
  boxplot(
    as.data.frame(pa_gse_diag_mat_ordered),
    add = TRUE,
    outline = FALSE,
    xaxt = "n",
    col = pa_gse_sample_box_cols,
    border = pa_gse_sample_border_cols,
    boxwex = 0.35,
    lwd = 0.6,
    medlwd = 0.6,
    whisklty = 1,
    staplelty = 1
  )
  
  ## Separator between GSE13294 and GSE13067
  abline(
    v = pa_gse_batch_end[1] + 0.5,
    lty = 2,
    col = "grey40",
    lwd = 1
  )
  
  ## Batch labels on x-axis
  axis(
    side = 1,
    at = (pa_gse_batch_start + pa_gse_batch_end) / 2,
    labels = pa_gse_batch_runs$values,
    tick = FALSE,
    cex.axis = 0.9
  )
  
  legend(
    "right",
    legend = names(pa_gse_box_cols),
    fill = pa_gse_legend_box_cols,
    border = pa_gse_box_cols,
    bty = "n",
    title = "Batch",
    cex = 0.85,
    inset = c(0.01, 0)
  )
}

## 8) Plot on screen
pa_gse_draw_post_alignment_boxplot()

## 9) Save plot
pa_gse_outfile <- file.path(
  result_dir,
  "post_alignment_diagnostic_feature_boxplot_GSE13294_vs_GSE13067.png"
)

png(
  filename = pa_gse_outfile,
  width = 4200,
  height = 1500,
  res = 300
)

pa_gse_draw_post_alignment_boxplot()

dev.off()

cat("Saved post-alignment diagnostic-feature boxplot to:\n")
cat(pa_gse_outfile, "\n")
```

# 11) Run ml_sum from SSV summary.R

```{r run-ml-sum}
cat("Running ml_sum() using SSV summary.R.\n")
cat("data_type_rnaseq = FALSE because the input is RMA microarray continuous expression.\n")
cat("batch_time = TRUE and early_batch_id = c(1), so split=100 means GSE13067-only training and GSE13294-only testing.\n")
cat("batch_balance =", batch_balance, "keeps the original matched sample sizes.\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

ml_sum(
  n = times,
  data = data_final_clean_internal,
  class = class_id_binary_internal,
  batch = batch_id_final_internal,
  batch_time = TRUE,
  early_batch_id = c(1),
  batch_balance = batch_balance,
  ml = ml_methods,
  split_combination = split_combination,
  data_type_rnaseq = FALSE,
  file = file_prefix
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
run_time <- end_time - start_time
cat("ml_sum run time:\n")
print(run_time)
```
